title: nassella vallsii
intro:
Nassella vallsii, commonly known as Valls' needle grass, is a species of grass native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Nassella vallsii include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of digestive issues due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
